description: This Java class 'ModelDataFileReader' reads and parses XML configuration files defining data file models, including records and fields, for the OFBiz framework. It manages caching of readers, constructs data file models from XML, and provides access to data file definitions.

classes.name: ModelDataFileReader
classes.description: A final class responsible for reading and parsing XML data file model definitions, managing cache, and providing access to data file models.

methods.name: getModelDataFileReader
methods.description: Returns a cached or new instance of ModelDataFileReader for a given URL.

methods.name: createModelDataFile
methods.description: Creates a ModelDataFile object from an XML element, parsing attributes and nested records.

methods.name: createModelDataFiles
methods.description: Reads the XML document from the URL and constructs a map of data file names to ModelDataFile objects.

methods.name: createModelField
methods.description: Creates a ModelField object from an XML element, parsing attributes.

methods.name: createModelRecord
methods.description: Creates a ModelRecord object from an XML element, parsing attributes and nested fields.

methods.name: getDataFileNames
methods.description: Returns a collection of data file names defined in the XML.

methods.name: getDataFileNamesIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over data file names.

methods.name: getModelDataFile
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelDataFile object by name.

methods.name: getModelDataFiles
methods.description: Returns the map of all data file models.
